description: In every PA-model, if \(m\ne0\) and \(m,n\) are coprime, there are nonnegative coefficients with \(mu+nv=1+mu'+nv'\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.bezout_model.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (m n : M)
  (hm : m ≠ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M)
  (hcop : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.CoprimeModel M m n) :
  ∃ v,
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M m (v 0))
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M n (v 1)) =
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1)
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M m (v 2))
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M n (v 3)))
